items.title: PM pays tribute to 'personal friend' and former neighbour Richard Scolyer
items.description: Loved ones of former Australian of the Year Richard Scolyer have paid tribute to his legacy, with his family saying he "wanted cancer patients to know they weren't alone".

items.title: Live: Israel strikes Iran despite Trump urging Netanyahu not to retaliate
items.description: Israel says it struck military targets in western and central Iran after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched a series of strikes against northern Israel. Follow live.

items.title: Tsunami threat after magnitude-7.8 earthquake in southern Philippines
items.description: A powerful magnitude-7.8 earthquake has shaken the Mindanao region in the southern Philippines, with a tsunami possible on some regional coasts.

items.title: Live: Fans gather at MCG for Big Freeze ahead of Collingwood-Melbourne clash
items.description: Thousands of fans partake in a walk to the MCG for the Big Freeze slide in honour of Neale Daniher before Collingwood takes on Melbourne. Follow live.

items.title: Tasmania's population boom has gone bust and it spells trouble
items.description: From being a hot destination 10 years ago, Tasmania's population growth has ground to a halt. Big changes will be needed to reverse the trend, experts say.

items.title: 'Desert' of floating rock traps islands after undersea volcanic eruption
items.description: Residents are concerned about access to food and fresh water as pumice stone makes travel difficult for Papua New Guinea's seafaring communities.

items.title: Trump storms out of interview after grilling on 'crooked' election claims
items.description: US President Donald Trump angrily storms out of an interview with American broadcaster NBC after he was questioned about his unfounded claims of election fraud.

items.title: UK, France and Germany back Zelenskyy's call for meeting with Putin
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has received the backing of the leaders of the UK, France and Germany in calling for direct ceasefire talks with Russia.

items.title: It's an AI behemoth. Now Anthropic is making a power play in Australia
items.description: The world's biggest tech titans see Australia as a promising investment opportunity for their AI ambitions, but some fear the federal government's regulatory retreat could cause more harm.

items.title: When a detective told a witness Joanna was pregnant, she took police to VCAT
items.description: A woman who says she suffered life-changing stress and anxiety — and later, the death of one of her babies — after a Victoria Police officer unlawfully disclosed that she was pregnant wants her story known.

items.title: Top neurologists say regulator ignored warnings as weed killer decision looms
items.description: Australia's leading movement disorder specialists say the chemical regulator has not engaged with their concerns about paraquat, despite growing evidence linking the herbicide to Parkinson's disease.

items.title: Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan decries sexist Melbourne billboard
items.description: Premier Jacinta Allan has been joined by Anthony Albanese, Julia Gillard and other politicians — except for Pauline Hanson — in denouncing the language used to describe her on political signs seen in the Melbourne CBD.

items.title: Indigenous families want 'crisis' investigated after 15 deaths in six months
items.description: Remote Indigenous communities across Australia are painfully aware that their life expectancy rates are worsening — and in one Northern Territory community, residents are calling for an investigation into a local death rate they feel is "not normal".

items.title: WA Opposition Leader Basil Zempilas says One Nation deserves 'respect'
items.description: The WA Liberal leader says growing support for One Nation reflects frustration with Labor, and that he is open to finding a way of working with Pauline Hanson's party.

items.title: Secrets of Indigenous astronomy revealed in new exhibition
items.description: Newcastle Art Gallery presents the distinctive and intricate work of Torres Strait Islander artist Brian Robinson in its first major solo survey following a four-year refurbishment.

items.title: History quiz: When was the first Mars Exploration Rover launch?
items.description: What make of car was stolen in the world's first official vehicle theft? And do you know where the Endeavour was repaired after hitting the Great Barrier Reef in 1770?

items.title: With his pet chihuahua and trusty gopher, 97yo grazier won't slow down
items.description: At 97, Doug Harrison still scoots around his outback station, doing as much work as he can. As he nears a century of living, he reflects on memorable moments over the decades, with a cuppa in hand and his trusty chihuahua by his side.

items.title: The electric classic car that now drives like a 'pocket rocket'
items.description: It may look like a small vintage car, but an EV conversion has brought it "up to speed" to its modern counterparts.

items.title: Obscene acts charges prompt calls for more CCTV
items.description: A woman who reported a terrifying incident while walking at night in Derby says more CCTV cameras would increase safety and help monitor popular locations.

items.title: SA government says crackdown is leading to illicit tobacco price increase
items.description: South Australia's Consumer and Business Affairs Minister says a price increase for illegal tobacco noticed by inspectors within stores shows the trade is being disrupted.

items.title: Suppression order extended for name of high-profile Qld man in extortion case
items.description: The court has heard the accused man threatened to expose an affair his former partner allegedly had with the married high-profile Queenslander in 2017.

items.title: Family loses everything as large fire destroys house
items.description: Fallen powerlines electrified a metal fence encircling the home before a gas cylinder "went off like a rocket" as a house in Warilla is engulfed within minutes.

items.title: Does being in a 'safe seat' influence whether your hospital gets an upgrade?
items.description: Are hospitals in safe seats being overlooked for multi-million-dollar refurbishments by the Victorian government?

items.title: Piastri promoted after penalty as teen sensation wins wild Monaco GP
items.description: Teenage sensation Kimi Antonelli was flawless to lead every lap of a drama-filled Monaco Grand Prix, claiming a fifth consecutive win to extend his lead in the Formula 1 drivers' championship. Follow live.

items.title: Korda wins US Women's Open title with perilous final putt
items.description: Nelly Korda claims the US Women's Open for her second consecutive major victory, holding off Charley Hull and Gaby Lopez by one shot in Los Angeles.
